label: MiniMax M2.7
summary: More explicit constraints, stronger anti-hallucination, stricter file/artifact structure.
claim_notes: MiniMax adapter rules are working hypotheses until project evals confirm them.
Official model material can support capability priors, not all listed failure modes.
failure_modes: Weak separation between supported claims and assumptions
rules: Use explicit constraints and negative rules.
Preserve gaps instead of filling them with plausible prose.
Require named artifacts when files or outputs are requested.
Separate supported claims, assumptions, and missing information.
